plan.notes: Transcribed from the official College of Marin Career Education Catalog (cte.marin.edu, Academic Year 2022-2023), Registered Dental Assisting program page. PROGRAM OFFERINGS lists 'Certificate of Achievement in Dental Assisting, Registered (15.0 units)'. The FALL CORE CLASSES block sums to exactly 15.0 (DENT 172 3, DENT 174 3, DENT 176 3, DENT 180 3, DENT 182 3), matching the certificate total; the catalog publishes no separate course list for the certificate, so the certificate is modeled as the Fall core block. The SPRING (20.0) and SUMMER (2.5) core blocks belong to the 60-unit AS degree major core and are excluded here. The 60-unit AS degree is NOT collected: its total includes general education with no official term placement (honest negative). The 2018-2019 full catalog describes this as a sequential program whose courses must be taken in the semester offered. All classes at Indian Valley Campus; scheduling subject to change.
